RedsurCase.title: RedSur Data Governance Portal
RedsurCase.subtitle: Data governance portal that demonstrates the full data lifecycle: from dirty official sources to reliable business decisions, with medallion architecture, RBAC and production deployment.
RedsurCase.problemP1: RedSur Distribuciones S.A.S. is a fictional mass-consumption company in regional growth. The problem is real: scattered data, no access control, no traceability and no single source of truth. Each area with its own Excel.
RedsurCase.problemP2: The starting point was real data from the 2023 DANE Annual Commerce Survey: CSV with Colombian decimal separator, technical columns without context, non-official department codes and values in thousands of pesos without clarification. 14,837 records, 10 departments, 9 sectors and more than 545 billion pesos in analyzed sales.
RedsurCase.architectureIntro: Three-layer medallion architecture, a standard in modern data engineering:
RedsurCase.rawDesc: Unmodified DANE data in PostgreSQL. Governance rule: do not touch the source.
RedsurCase.stagingDesc: dbt Core cleans, renames, translates codes and calculates derived fields.
RedsurCase.martsDesc: Business tables: sales by department, sector, personnel by region.
RedsurCase.portalP: Real authentication with JWT and bcrypt passwords. Admin, Editor and Viewer roles. Dashboard access is not free: the user requests access, the admin approves or rejects, and only then receives credentials. If access is revoked, the workspace disappears from their view. Tangible RBAC.
RedsurCase.challenge1Desc: Render free plan is not enough for Metabase. They were rebuilt in React + Recharts with Supabase data.
RedsurCase.challenge2Desc: SMTP blocked on Render free. Solution with Resend (email API).
RedsurCase.challenge3Desc: Backup of more than one million characters. Migration via pipeline from Docker, without going through the SQL editor.
RedsurCase.show1Desc: It is not a coding exercise: it is a use case with a coherent solution.
RedsurCase.show2Desc: Knowing how to clean and interpret official sources, not just sample datasets.
RedsurCase.show3Desc: Pipeline, database, secure backend and access system.
RedsurCase.show4Desc: Free deployment coordinating several services and solving real restrictions.
